registry push and digest pin of a release build (the image id above is the local build)
compose wiring with the TLS entrypoint (the base entrypoint is unchanged, so deploy/docs/postgres.sh should work as is)

sbom_gate.added_on_top_of_base: pgvector 0.8.0 (PostgreSQL License), gosu 1.19 (Apache-2.0, shipped by the official base), docker-library entrypoint scripts (MIT)
sbom_gate.caveat: the gate lists the 144 Debian packages of the base as base-os and does not gate them; the base is the official image pinned by digest and its Debian packages (bash, coreutils, tar and others under GPL) are not distributed by us beyond the image itself. A legal review of redistributing the image is still the D67 gate.

decision: Use oo-docs-pgvector:dev for vectors. The supabase image is not used. deploy/docs/images.lock.json change is in patches/C-L8-images-lock-pgvector-minimal.patch (integration lane applies it).

image.name: supabase/postgres
image.source: image already present in the local store; the registry is not reachable from this host, so nothing was pulled
image.base: Ubuntu 24.04, PostgreSQL 17.6 built with nix, pgvector 0.8.0 (vector.control default_version 0.8.0)

sbom_gate.tool: tools/super-ontology/sbom_nix_image.py (nix-store -qR closure of postgresql-and-plugins-17.6 plus dpkg list) then tools/doc-parser/sbom_gate.py
sbom_gate.forbidden_licences: GPL-2.0/3.0 components in the closure: postgis, pgrouting, bash, coreutils, gnupg, gnutar, gzip, gnugrep, readline, cryptsetup, iptables, util-linux, lvm2 and others (the gate also fails 'X AND GPL' dual-part tools such as lz4 and xz). Licences are upstream licences asserted by package name; nix store paths carry no licence metadata.
sbom_gate.missing_audit: 13 components have no licence assertion (dns-root-data, http, index_advisor, mecab dictionaries, nghttp2, publicsuffix-list, switch-ext-version and others).
sbom_gate.pgvector_itself: vector 0.8.0 is PostgreSQL License and passes alone; the failure comes from the other Supabase extensions and OS tools in the image, not from pgvector.

previous_image_rejected.reason: gate FAIL (GPL tools and extensions, 13 unasserted licences)
